what: Lens suite (web/shaders/lens): GPU pass against the float64 CPU reference
source: synthetic HDR frames and a Wet Street frame at 192 x 108; the same f32 input feeds both sides; the source list is extracted on the CPU and shared
why: Every term is continuous in its inputs (ghost edges are a one-pixel ramp, tables are sampled bilinearly), so f32 against f64 moves values by rounding only; 3 codes covers the steepest ramp at the encode's shoulder.
